1) Document classification
- Found explicit invoice indicators: title "Rechnung", "Nummer", "Datum", "Nettobetrag", "Mwst.", "Gesamtbetrag", line items with quantities/prices. No exclusion keywords (e.g., "Mahnung") in prominent positions. Conclusion: document is an invoice.

2) Locate fields and verify
- Invoice Date: located near header "Datum: 25.01.2024".
- Sender VAT ID: header shows "Unsere UID-Nr.: ATU 64424288" → VAT = "ATU 64424288".
- Grand Total: "Gesamtbetrag EUR 723,99" → candidate 723,99.
- Net Amount: "Nettobetrag EUR 658,17" → candidate 658,17.
- VAT grouping: "10% Mwst. von 658,17 EUR 65,82" — VAT rate = 10, VAT amount = 65,82.
  - This is a single invoice-level VAT group applicable to the whole invoice (not per-line exclusive), so include it.
- Confirm consistency: Net + VAT = 658,17 + 65,82 = 723,99 matches Grand Total.

3) Formatting and rules considerations
- Do not infer missing values; all required values are present.
- VAT rate should be returned without the percent sign ("10").
- Preserve decimal places as in the source (two decimals, comma used in source).
- Schema expects numeric types for amounts/rate; will convert to numeric representation preserving decimals.

4) Final decision (to be output in next step)
- Extract these values:
  - Invoice.Date = "25.01.2024"
  - Sender.VatId = "ATU 64424288"
  - GrandTotal.Amount = 723.99 (preserve two decimals)
  - Net.Amount = 658.17
  - Vat.Rate = 10
  - Vat.Amount = 65.82
